title: Hardship Relief on the Security Deposits Reconnection Deposit for Energy Assistance and Medical Certificates
content:
Members whose household receives energy assistance or is covered by a medical certificate receive hardship relief on the reconnection multiple of the Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit assessed under Security Deposits when a Schedule R or Schedule FH account whose waived deposit was reinstated is reconnected.

## Terms

The hardship relief is the full hardship relief of **0.5** when the account received an energy assistance payment from LIHEAP in the last twelve months and a medical certificate, accepted or not, was received for the account in the last twelve months; it is the single hardship relief of **0.25** when exactly one of those two holds; and it is nothing when neither does. The hardship relief is taken off the reconnection multiple. The reconnection multiple is never below **2.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

Both are read from the account's Electric Service by Rate Schedule records: payments received from LIHEAP as the assistance agency, and medical certificates by the date they were received, whatever their outcome.

## Combinations

| LIHEAP payment in the last twelve months | Medical certificate received in the last twelve months | Hardship relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.5 |
| yes | no | 0.25 |
| no | yes | 0.25 |
| no | no | nothing |

A certificate that was received but not accepted still counts. Only a payment received from LIHEAP counts on the assistance side: an energy assistance pledge recorded on the account is not a payment received, and a payment from another agency is not a LIHEAP payment.
